phase: representation engineering followed by separately gated clinical comparison
pilot_source: previously inspected PPG-DaLiA development S1-S5, sitting and walking
preprocessing: per-segment mean/std, fourth-order Chebyshev-II 20dB 0.5-12Hz filtfilt within past 8s only, resample_poly 25/32
preprocessing_limitation: bounded-window adaptation, not reproduction of authors whole-record normalization/filtering
pilot_evaluation: finite representations, determinism, batch consistency, actual runtime; no clinical claims

next_comparison.selection: mean subject validation AP; event threshold on validation only
next_comparison.test_use: once per locked comparison; already-seen PhysioCGM remains exploratory
next_comparison.background_gate: verified same-subject linkage and available-before-cutoff; otherwise absent, never imputed from another cohort
next_comparison.model_gate: temporal pretraining uses training subjects only; do not call random frozen temporal layers pretrained
